additions.label: Current/deleted file-domain location selector

evidence.description: Existing GUI/model regression compares current/deleted tick lists, combined-domain exclusion and selected domain contexts against the reference recording. Not rerun in this audit.
Reference domain menus and multi-location selections with advanced mode off/on.

limitations: Qt caller flags can restrict importable/local/combined domains independently; native ordinary/autocomplete entrypoints expose two modes rather than the complete flag matrix.
additions.assessment: The native current/deleted service checklist loads the current LocationContext, clears domains covered by combined selections on each toggle, and returns a normalized detached context only on Apply. Autocomplete callers deliberately expose all-known/advanced choices. Caller-specific Qt restricted-domain flag combinations are not all represented by this generic selector.
